messages:
Rosa (PM): Quick thread — product wants to try a partial-eviction routing pattern: when cost pressure hits, route low-priority cohorts to cheaper quantized model variants instead of a blanket degrade. Looking for ops + SRE feedback on safety/telemetry/launch criteria.

Devin (Eng): Which cohorts count as 'low-priority'? and how do we name the feature flag?

Rosa (PM): Low-priority = non-paying/free tier, experimental cohorts, and certain internal probes. Flag name proposal: `feature.partial_eviction_routing`.

Tiago (SRE): Main SRE concerns: (1) we must keep observed SLOs for paying customers untouched, (2) kill-switch must be instant and global, (3) telemetry to detect quality regressions quickly.

Ashley (ProdOps): From rollout perspective: want A/B gating and a clear metric contract. Minimum telemetry: latency_p95, error_rate, token_cost_per_request, and eval-set quality delta. Dashboard hooks + alert thresholds needed.

Devin (Eng): Draft flag/config for discussion:
```
flag: partial_eviction_routing
cohorts:
  - low_priority
  - internal_experiments
models:
  - gptq-4x-8bit
  - gpt-4-classic
canary_schedule: [1, 5, 20]  # percents
kill_conditions:
  - latency_p95 > 500ms
  - regression_pct_on_eval > 1.5
```
(we'll wire this into the routing policy and fallback map)

Tiago (SRE): Canary sounds right. My suggestion for hold gates: hold for at least 30m at each step, require latency_p95 delta <= +50ms and regression_pct_on_eval <= 0.8% to advance. If any kill_condition hits, immediate rollback and route everyone back to primary models. Add /runbook link in the flag.

SREBot: Note: auto-eviction policy can be bound to `sre.eviction` webhook. If SLO breach detected for paying-tier, SREBot will set flag to OFF and notify #eng-oncall.

Devin (Eng): Need to clarify customer opt-outs: enterprise tenants should be able to opt-out via tenant flag. We'll expose `tenant.partial_eviction_opt_out = true`.

Ashley (ProdOps): A/B test design: randomize low-priority users into control (primary models) vs experiment (evicted variant). Collect token_cost, latency, and a paired subset of eval prompts for quality sampling. Rollout pass criteria: cost reduction >= 12% AND quality regression <= 0.5% AND no increase in paid-customer errors.

Rosa (PM): Great. Action items: Devin -> PR for flag + routing config, Tiago -> ops runbook + kill-switch wiring, Ashley -> dashboard panels + eval set. Target soft-launch canary next Wed.

Devin (Eng): I'll open the PR today and include the config snippet + unit tests.

Tiago (SRE): I'll draft the runbook and alert thresholds. Will add the `sre.eviction` webhook binding.

Ashley (ProdOps): I'll prep the dashboard and evaluation harness, and ping analytics for cohort definitions.

Rosa (PM): Thanks — @Devin @Tiago @Ashley please ack here when you have PR/runbook/dashboard links so we can schedule the shiproom. :thumbsup:

Devin (Eng): ack :+1:

Tiago (SRE): ack :white_check_mark:

Ashley (ProdOps): ack :rocket:
